title: SESSION808_SEED_INVENTORY
description: Inventory of remaining Unprocessed seed items in Pack C and Pack D Section E. These seeds are the original (non-clone) Domain E items that require six-dimension AI verification (CAQS §1.6) before certification.
seed_definition: A seed is the original, independently authored item within a 5-item rotation group. Seeds are structurally distinct from clones (which share identical stems with only company-name substitution and answer-letter rotation). Seeds must pass full CAQS §1.6 verification before certification.

certification_blockers.template_rotation_artifact: Pack C/D Section E items were authored in 5-item rotation groups. Seeds share the same pipeline root as clones — structural defect patterns (DL-008, DL-013) are likely present.
certification_blockers.cc_audit_required: CorrectChoice values must be independently verified before certification — DL-030 pattern established.

seed_selection_methodology: Seeds are identified from the DL-012 clone finding: each 5-item rotation group contains 1 seed and 4 clones. After clone archival and replacement, the surviving non-clone items in Pack C/Pack D Section E that remain Unprocessed are the seeds. Certified items within Section E have already passed the seed certification process.
